clusters.description:
Reading: Component(s).SugarPortion -[is an inseparable part of]-> TeaPortion.Composite.

SugarPortion end — role: Component, multiplicity 0..1
(a TeaPortion contains at most one SugarPortion —
unsweetened tea is perfectly valid, hence the lower bound of 0.)

TeaPortion end — role: Composite, multiplicity 1 (default, not shown)
(a dissolved SugarPortion belongs to exactly one TeaPortion.
Once dissolved, it cannot exist independently.)

Composition semantics (filled diamond):
Once sugar is dissolved in tea, it cannot be separated back out
by any natural means.
When the tea is drunk, the sugar is consumed along with it.
A dissolved SugarPortion may belong to at most one TeaPortion
at any point in time.

Reading: Content(s).TeaPortion -[is poured into]-> Glass(es).Vessel.

TeaPortion end — role: Content, multiplicity 0..1
(a Glass may be empty (0),
or contain exactly one TeaPortion (1).)

Glass end — role: Vessel, multiplicity 1..*
(a TeaPortion must be poured into at least one Glass —
but it may also be split across two glasses to cool faster.)

Aggregation semantics (hollow diamond):
Tea can be poured from one Glass into another,
or split across several glasses.
The TeaPortion exists independently of any particular Glass —
the Glass is just the vessel, not the owner.
